summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery uses single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, generation identity, artifact hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; older LKG allowed only if ancestor and all indexed inputs byte-match main; restores source snapshot, v2 Catalog, projections, v1 compatibility Catalog, then publication/query/smoke validation; stale LKG never overrides newer main; failed checks/activation roll back and verify all four layers and pointers, with current pointer last; publication scripts/control plane must byte-match pinned main; stale locks may recover only definitely dead/reused owners or malformed locks after 60s, live/indeterminate owners conflict; pruning is separate explicit prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protect current, LKG, and five newest valid successful generations; success requires complete manifest/artifact/layer/policy/source/query checks, never mtime; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized generations are reported and retained; pruning requires canonical current-main policy, intent and per-target authorization, atomic isolation, and evidence for removed/remaining/failed cleanup; failure logs append-only and outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements and does not supersede ADR-0044/0048; retention policy versioned and ADR-governed.
